question: In the pulverized-coal boiler, how many tonnes of coal per hour does 40% NH3 blending save compared with pure coal firing?
rendered:
According to the text, under pure coal firing, the total coal feed rate is 166.14 t·h^− 1. At 40% NH3 blending, the coal feeding rate is 30.5 kg·s^− 1. 

To convert this to tonnes per hour, we multiply by 3600 seconds per hour and divide by 1000 kilograms per tonne. 

30.5 kg·s^− 1 * 3600 s·h^− 1 / 1000 kg·t^− 1 = 109.8 t·h^− 1

So, 40% NH3 blending saves 166.14 t·h^− 1 - 109.8 t·h^− 1 = 56.34 t·h^− 1 of coal compared with pure coal firing.
